title: Exercise Stress Test Protocol for Mice
author: Louise Lantier
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yxcfxiw
materials: After 3 min, speed is increased by 4m/min.

steps.title: Familiarize mice with treadmill
steps.instruction: Two days prior to the experiment, familiarize mice with the treadmill by exercising them for 10 minutes at 10m/min.

steps.title: Acclimatize mice and initialize system
steps.instruction: Place the mouse in the stopped treadmill for 45 min to acclimatize and start the Oxymax system.

substeps.instruction: Ensure treadmill is equipped with a shock pad

steps.title: Collect basal measurements
steps.instruction: Perform basal measurements for 15 min while the mouse is in the stopped treadmill.

steps.title: Perform graded exercise stress test
steps.instruction: Increase treadmill speed every three minutes by 4m/min until the mouse reaches exhaustion.

substeps.instruction: Define exhaustion as the point where the mouse remains on the shock pad for 5 continuous seconds

steps.title: Allow recovery
steps.instruction: Once exhaustion is reached, leave the mouse in the stopped treadmill for 30 min to recover.
